title: build(deps): bump marked from 18.0.10 to 18.0.12
intent: Routine Dependabot currency, no advisory. marked 18.0.10 -> 18.0.12 in packages/client (runtime dependency). Patch-level: 10 upstream parser-conformance fixes across 18.0.11 and 18.0.12, no API change. Authored by hand because Dependabot cannot author a manifest (CBSP21-NOBORROW-001); the payload of that friction is the lockfile audit in behavior_change.
behavior_change: none in the shipped app. Lockfile audited against merge base 7685411c (= origin/main at audit time; the branch is not behind main) by parsing both package-lock.json trees and comparing every `packages` entry in full, not by reading the diff view. Entry count is 412 before and 412 after. Exactly 1 entry changed version: marked 18.0.10 -> 18.0.12, with only its `resolved` (registry.npmjs.org, both sides) and `integrity` fields moving alongside. Zero packages added, zero removed, zero entries whose version stayed the same while other fields changed, apart from the root entry, which differs in exactly one key: dependencies.marked ^18.0.10 -> ^18.0.12. The new integrity hash equals the value the npm registry publishes for marked@18.0.12 (sha512-LEm4ga2Y...GuFScA==), so the tarball is the genuine release. Consumer analysis: marked has exactly one importer in packages/client/src, views/RMOSCncJobDetailView.vue, and that view is not mounted -- it is absent from router/index.ts, referenced by no other client file, and unreachable from src/main.ts in a full static+dynamic import-graph walk (824 of 1434 source files reachable; this one is not). A module no entry reaches is not bundled, so no user-facing code path renders with marked today.

diff_articulation.what_changed: packages/client/package.json moves the single declared range for marked from ^18.0.10 to ^18.0.12 -- one line, no other dependency touched. package-lock.json resolves it: marked 18.0.10 -> 18.0.12. No incidental version movement; the added, removed and non-marked changed sets are all empty. Upstream content (release notes, markedjs/marked): 18.0.11 -- no nested link inside a link; per-call reflink-mask rebuild; keep emphasis in a rejected reference link. 18.0.12 -- tab before an ATX closing sequence; one more level of nested link-label brackets; no newline added to an empty code block; escape character references in autolink destinations; reject GFM email autolinks whose domain ends in _ or -; reject invalid characters in HTML tag names; strip fence indentation per content line. All are CommonMark/GFM conformance fixes; two of them tighten the HTML marked emits.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Dependabot currency, stated plainly. No existing manifest covers this diff, and five manifests written for other dependency work (dep-sec-001a-tier1-remediation, dep-sec-pr281-types-node, dep-sec-pr287-zod4, dep-sec-pr302-jsdom-happy-dom, happy-dom-20.14.0-bump) would each have covered these two files -- the CBSP21 gate named all five and refused to borrow them, which is CBSP21-NOBORROW-001 working as designed.

architecture_scan.acknowledgement_notes: Dependency bump; no architectural surface; this PR introduces no finding. Recorded here because the audit surfaced it, NOT because this PR causes it: the only marked consumer, views/RMOSCncJobDetailView.vue, renders server-supplied markdown (job.operator_report_md) through marked() straight into v-html, and packages/client declares no HTML sanitizer. marked does not sanitize its output. The view is unmounted today, so the sink is latent rather than exploitable -- but routing that view as it stands would open a stored-XSS path. That is a separate, pre-existing issue for its own order; it is not remediated in a dependency bump.
